user.title: LPG tank
user.description: The level is derived from your heating system's gas consumption – no sensor on the tank required.

data_description.sources: The cumulative counters of your heating system, e.g. heating gas and domestic hot water gas. Multiple sensors are added up.
data_description.source_unit: Automatic takes the unit from the sensors (m³, L or kWh).
data_description.capacity: Total volume of the tank as stated on the type plate.
data_description.max_fill: Usually 85 % for LPG – the rest is expansion space.

details.title: Conversion and forecast
details.description: The defaults suit propane according to DIN 51622. Everything can be changed later under “Configure”.

data_description.liter_per_m3: Propane at standard conditions: about 3.92. Calibrated automatically on the first refill if you enter the gauge reading beforehand.
data_description.kwh_per_liter: Net calorific value 6.57 – gross 7.11. 7.0 is a good middle ground.
data_description.price_per_liter: Only for the value display, does not affect the forecast.
data_description.reserve: Below this amount the tank counts as empty – basis for the ordering deadline.
data_description.lead_time: How long it takes from ordering to the tanker arriving.
data_description.profile_years: Over how many years the consumption per calendar month is averaged.
data_description.correction: Scales the entire forecast – useful after insulation work or a rebuild.
data_description.price_entity: Optional. Only a writable number – an input_number or number entity you set yourself. A template sensor explicitly does not work: it computes itself and cannot be written back. If the helper is in EUR/m³ the integration converts to litres. Change it by hand and the integration follows immediately; a price entered on refill is written back into it. Leave empty and the integration provides its own “Gas price” number.

error.keine_quelle: Please select at least one consumption sensor.

init.description: Changes take effect immediately; the tank is reloaded.

betankung.name: Register refill
betankung.description: Registers a delivery and restarts consumption counting. Partial refills included: the new level is the previous level plus the delivered amount.

liter.name: Delivered amount
liter.description: Litres delivered according to the delivery note.

fuellstand_vorher_prozent.name: Gauge before refilling
fuellstand_vorher_prozent.description: Optional. Used to recalibrate the m³ to litres conversion for your installation.

fuellstand_nachher_prozent.name: Gauge after refilling
fuellstand_nachher_prozent.description: Optional, takes precedence over the delivered amount because it is measured directly.

preis_pro_liter.name: Price per litre
preis_pro_liter.description: Optional, kept in the delivery history.

datum.name: Date
datum.description: Optional. Refills entered later are offset against the consumption recorded on that day.

kalibrieren.name: Recalibrate conversion
kalibrieren.description: Only effective if the gauge before refilling is given.

fuellstand_setzen.name: Set level
fuellstand_setzen.description: Sets the level to a value you read off and restarts counting.

prozent.name: Gauge
prozent.description: Percentage read from the mechanical gauge.

liter.name: Litres
liter.description: Alternatively the level directly in litres.

lieferung_nachtragen.name: Add past delivery
lieferung_nachtragen.description: Records a past delivery in the history only – for the price trend. Level and reference point stay untouched, unlike “Register refill”.

preis_pro_liter.name: Price per litre
preis_pro_liter.description: The price paid back then, in EUR/L.

profil_neu_berechnen.name: Recalculate monthly profile
profil_neu_berechnen.description: Re-reads the monthly consumption of recent years from long-term statistics.
